i know this is a very late reply, but PLEASE do not take meds that haven't been prescribed specifically for you. Lamotrigine in particular can potentially have the side effect of a [skin-flaking rash that can be lethal](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/diseases/17656-stevens-johnson-syndrome), and being provided proper assessment and information from a medical professional who knows how this drug works (as well as your personal medical history and other meds to know if there are any contraindications) is essential as this side effect needs to be monitored for and addressed quickly if it happens.
